name: GhostCommandPaletteTrigger
description: Optional opener with GhostDialogTrigger semantics (type="button", aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, aria-controls). Disabled when the root is disabled.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the trigger control.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables opening from this trigger; the root `disabled` also applies.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Opener with class ghost-command-palette-trigger and data-part="trigger".

states.name: open
states.description: data-state="open" while the palette is open, otherwise closed.
